title: Perspective Room public component schemas
description: Generated from the supplied OpenAPI components for standalone validation. OpenAPI is authoritative.

ForkCreate.description: At most one non-null before_message_id/through_message_id. Ordinary fork with both null copies all committed history. edit/regenerate require before_message_id pointing to a user message and forbid mode override. Source must be idle, non-archived and not evaluation-managed. folder_id omitted inherits source folder; explicit null unfiles. See document 08.

SessionOrganizationPatch.description: At least one mutable field is required. Archive requires an idle session. Archived sessions allow only title or is_archived=false; restore first for other mutations. Organization updates do not increment content version.
